description: This Java interface defines a repository for WidgetType entities, providing database query methods for retrieving widget type data, including by ID, tenant, bundle, and FQN, as well as batch processing.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeById
methods.description: Retrieves a WidgetTypeEntity by its UUID.

methods.name: existsByTenantIdAndId
methods.description: Checks if a widget type exists for a given tenant ID and widget type ID.

methods.name: findTenantWidgetTypeDetailsByTenantId
methods.description: Finds paginated widget type details for a specific tenant, with optional text search.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget types associated with a specific widget bundle ID.

methods.name: findWidgetTypesDetailsByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Finds widget type details associated with a specific widget bundle ID.

methods.name: findWidgetFqnsByWidgetsBundleId
methods.description: Retrieves FQNs of widget types associated with a specific widget bundle ID.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeIdsByTenantIdAndFqns
methods.description: Finds widget type ID and FQN pairs for a tenant based on a list of FQNs.

methods.name: findWidgetTypeByTenantIdAndFqn
methods.description: Finds a widget type entity by tenant ID and FQN.

methods.name: findByTenantIdAndFqn
methods.description: Finds widget type details by tenant ID and FQN.

methods.name: getExternalIdById
methods.description: Retrieves external ID for a widget type by its UUID.

methods.name: findAllIds
methods.description: Retrieves all widget type IDs with pagination.

methods.name: findIdsByTenantId
methods.description: Retrieves widget type IDs for a specific tenant with pagination.

methods.name: findNextBatch
methods.description: Retrieves the next batch of widget types after a given ID, limited by a specified limit.
